answer: Paired receipts stop bulk fake identities. Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and registers one ocean claim. A mesa depot issues a receipt for that key; an auditor pairs claim with receipt, and a missing or reused receipt forfeits the bond. First filing 34, the k-th 34+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,530,500 to chase a 40,000 pool. Rented receipts fail: one saffron receipt cannot pair two claims. One honest identity spends 34 once, bond returned.
